replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the coefficients of x², x, and the constant term. To find stationary points, take the derivative of f(x), call it f'(x). Set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are where the slope is zero. Plug each back into the original function to get the corresponding y-value. These (x,y) pairs are your stationary points.
